scope: Primary papers, official project pages, author repositories, public artifacts; bounded literature search, not an exhaustive claim.

sources.title: AiF: Accelerating On-Device LLM Inference Using In-Flash Processing
sources.evidence: Local PDF and project evidence notes; selected original mapping/interface/evaluation sections checked.
sources.relevance: Equal full-chip row shards; CR-read and be-enc; direct baseline.
sources.code: No AiF-specific public artifact verified; NVMeVirt upstream is separate.

sources.title: Cambricon-LLM: A Chiplet-Based Hybrid Architecture for On-Device Inference of 70B LLM
sources.evidence: Original full-text architecture and hardware-aware tiling sections IV–VII checked.
sources.relevance: Page-sized atomic tiles, two-dimensional channel/core mapping, broadcast, NPU/flash partition; generic page-aware tiling is prior art.
sources.code: No hardware-paper artifact verified. AlibabaResearch/flash-llm is unrelated GPU sparse inference.

sources.title: Cambricon-FlexLLM
sources.evidence: Publication and author pages checked; ACM full text unavailable (403).
sources.relevance: Author description mentions grouping often-used-together data and workload adaptation; overlap with proposed mapping remains unresolved.

sources.title: DIAMoND: Dynamic Inference for Adaptive Edge MOE with Heterogeneous In-NAND and Near-DRAM Compute Architecture
sources.evidence: Official IEEE abstract and metadata only; full mapping mechanism not reviewed.
sources.relevance: Mask-based mapping for matrix/array size mismatch and online expert selection; must obtain full text before a novelty claim.

sources.title: NASiC: 3D NAND-based CAM-Selected Multibit CIM Architecture for Efficient On-Device Mixture-of-Experts LLM Inference
sources.evidence: Architecture sections 3 and methodology 4.1 checked; official abstract says accepted DAC 2026.
sources.relevance: Interleaved expert placement with CAM selection, multibit analog CIM; requires circuit changes, not merely software placement.

sources.title: NVLLM: A 3D NAND-Centric Architecture Enabling Edge on-Device LLM Inference
sources.evidence: Original sections 3.1–3.5 and methodology 4.1–4.2 checked; v2 dated 2026-08-04.
sources.relevance: Plane-lane clusters, segmented dot products and OoO ECC; evaluated dense models, not routed expert placement.

sources.title: Beyond Capacity: Scalable MoE LLM Inference via High-Bandwidth Flash with Direct GPU and HBM Paths
sources.evidence: Original architecture, expert data placement V-A2, and evaluation VI-A checked.
sources.relevance: Experts striped across HBF dies/planes; direct/relay routes. Four independent subarrays/plane is an explicit author assumption; not in-flash MAC.
sources.code: Upstream scale-snu/LLMSimulator cited; DASH modification not verified.

sources.title: Flash-Cosmos: In-Flash Bulk Bitwise Operations Using Inherent Computation Capability of NAND Flash Memory
sources.evidence: Original NAND/MWS/ESP/methodology sections checked by architecture agent.
sources.relevance: Bitwise multi-wordline sensing and programming constraints; not an interchangeable GEMV backend.

sources.title: LLM in a Flash: Efficient Large Language Model Inference with Limited Memory
sources.evidence: Apple official page and original sections 3.1–3.3 checked.
sources.relevance: Windowing and row-column bundling; coactivation bundling and data organization already studied; flash-to-DRAM, not physical chip mapping.

sources.title: BigMoMo: Efficient Inference of Large-Scale MoE with Speculative Decoding on Mobile Devices
sources.evidence: Original runtime on-flash organization 4.3 and scheduling 4.4 checked; v2 dated 2026-10-03.
sources.relevance: Co-loading hypergraph, contiguous anchor regions, expert swaps and background writes; logical contiguity, not specified NAND die/plane ownership. Some pruning changes computation.

sources.title: mbolt: profile-guided layout optimization for MoE model files
sources.evidence: Author README and repository metadata checked; not reproduced.
sources.relevance: Coactivation-based GGUF reordering, up/gate/down interleaving, merged parallel pread. This is public prior art, not raw NAND control.

sources.title: Flash-MoE SSD streaming engine
sources.evidence: Author README and file structure checked; technical-report PDF not reviewed.
sources.relevance: C/Metal, packed expert files, parallel pread, OS page cache. Performance headline not a same-routing comparison.

sources.title: MoE-Infinity
sources.evidence: Original activation/caching sections and current author README checked.
sources.relevance: Activation-aware tracing, cache and prefetch. Current repository has CPU/SSD tiers and differs from paper; do not retroactively attribute current features.

sources.title: EdgeMoE: Empowering Sparse Large Language Models on Mobile Devices
sources.evidence: Original expert quantization and management sections checked.
sources.relevance: Expert bitwidth, preloading and residency management; not NAND chip/plane placement.

sources.title: Fiddler
sources.evidence: Official abstract and author README checked.
sources.relevance: CPU/GPU execution choice and transfer control; not physical flash placement.

sources.title: Pre-gated MoE
sources.evidence: Official paper and artifact README checked.
sources.relevance: Changes gating to identify next-layer experts early; not a routing-preserving placement baseline.

sources.title: ProMoE
sources.evidence: Original method sections checked.
sources.relevance: Prediction, chunked prefetch, preemption and reordered ready inference.

sources.title: SwapMoE
sources.evidence: Official abstract and method overview checked.
sources.relevance: Virtual experts and dynamic residency with quality tradeoffs; not exact fixed physical mapping.

sources.title: Klotski: Efficient Mixture-of-Expert Inference via Expert-Aware Multi-Batch Pipeline
sources.evidence: Original sections 3–7 checked.
sources.relevance: Explicit weight sharing across batches; read-once/multi-input reuse alone is not new.

sources.title: PlaceMoE: Accelerating MoE Training through Expert Placement and Replica Coordination
sources.evidence: Original sections III-A/B/C checked.
sources.relevance: Co-selection grouping, replica allocation and token-to-copy mapping; GPU/NPU training, not NAND, but abstract replication combination is prior art.

sources.title: MoETuner
sources.evidence: Abstract and ILP method checked.
sources.relevance: Expert affinity/load/communication placement; adding a makespan objective alone is not new.

sources.title: FlashMoE: Reducing SSD I/O Bottlenecks via ML-Based Cache Replacement for Mixture-of-Experts Inference on Edge Devices
sources.evidence: Original sections 2–3 checked; v2 2026-10-05.
sources.relevance: Learned cache replacement, per-expert files; not physical NAND placement.

sources.title: FlashMoE: Fast Distributed MoE in a Single Kernel
sources.evidence: Author project page and repository checked.
sources.relevance: GPU-resident distributed kernel; unrelated to flash storage.

sources.title: ReadGuard: Integrated SSD Management for Priority-Aware Read Performance Differentiation
sources.evidence: Original indexed sections 4–7 and 9 checked; formatted full PDF not obtained.
sources.relevance: Block quality based on worst-page retries, application priorities, migration costs; near-zero retries remove heterogeneity headroom.
sources.code: Raw measured lookup tables and modified MQSim not located.

sources.title: Improving NAND flash performance with read heat separation
sources.evidence: Official IBM abstract and metadata checked.
sources.relevance: Hot-read data on low-latency pages, including commercial SSD-controller implementation; hot experts on fast pages is not new.

sources.title: Stress-Aware WL-Based Read Disturbance Management for High-Density NAND Flash Memory
sources.evidence: Earlier NVMW extended abstract read; 2026 official publication metadata only.
sources.relevance: Wordline-level stress/reclaim; adjacent and non-adjacent reads differ. Do not attribute unreviewed 2026 extensions to earlier text.

sources.title: Reducing Solid-State Drive Read Latency by Optimizing Read-Retry
sources.evidence: Original mechanism/characterization sections checked.
sources.relevance: CACHE READ and ECC-margin retry optimizations. CACHE READ is distinct from charge-recycling CR-read.

sources.title: QCFlash: Bulk Bitwise Processing in 3D NAND with Dynamic Sensing and Quad-level Encoding — Artifact
sources.evidence: Official artifact description, dataset scope and license checked; archive not downloaded.
sources.relevance: Measured QLC threshold voltages/shared-page data, MIT code and CC BY 4.0 data; not an end-to-end physical retry latency trace.

sources.title: NVMeVirt
sources.evidence: Upstream repository metadata and current project integration checked.
sources.relevance: Keep existing full-system replay infrastructure; upstream has no AiF GEMV by default.

sources.title: MQSim
sources.evidence: Official repository and commit checked.
sources.relevance: SSD queues, FTL, channel/GC modeling; no verified ReadGuard/STRAW extension bundled.

sources.title: FEMU
sources.evidence: Official current README checked.
sources.relevance: Full-system SSD/FTL/GC/open-channel research; emulator behavior must be validated, not a physical in-flash accelerator.

sources.title: CRZ OpenSSD OpenChannelSSD
sources.evidence: Official repository checked by architecture agent.
sources.relevance: Potential controller/FTL measurement platform; supported low-level NAND commands and actual hardware availability remain to verify.

sources.title: LLMSimulator
sources.evidence: Original DASH reference and upstream checked by architecture agent.
sources.relevance: DASH upstream foundation, not a verified DASH artifact.

sources.title: HBFSim
sources.evidence: Official README checked by architecture agent.
sources.relevance: GPU execution with modeled HBF timing; cannot supply measured AiF/retry parameters.

unresolved: No verified AiF-specific public artifact or raw ReadGuard/STRAW latency tables located.
FCMoE/FC-MoE and Edge-Infinity names not verified; not treated as established systems.
